data.description: If a giant moray begins a round with a grabbed foe, it inflicts automatic bite damage (2d6+%1 points of damage). A giant moray eel possesses a second set of jaws in its throat that aid in swallowing - it can make a second bite attack (same attack bonus, 1d6+%2 damage) against a foe it has already grabbed.
